scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @cloudbrowser/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply cloudbrowser --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm --filter @cloudbrowser/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply cloudbrowser --remote
